_notes: Chapter 1's opening film. It plays on a new game, before James appears on the train.

Each shot: image (the painting, when it exists), brief (what the painting shows: use it as the art prompt), palette (stand-in colours until then), seconds, fade (cross-fade seconds), move (slow pan and zoom: [zoom, x, y] from and to), snow (none, light, heavy), sound, music.
caption: words on black. black: true for a dark shot that only carries lines. title: the game's name over a shot. lines: dialogue lines, the same format as conversations.

Every caption and line here is word for word from docs/chapter-01-script.md, Scene 1. The film opens on the "Winter, 1986" card. Kessler's line is James's memory later, on the train (conversation ch01_train_thought), not part of this film.
Paintings go in res://assets/art/cinematics/ch01/ at 1920x1080 or larger, 16:9, anime style, matching docs/art-direction.md.

shots.caption:
Winter, 1986.
The forecast promised a clear night over the Harrow Pass.

shots.brief: Wide establishing shot, night, perfectly clear sky full of stars and a bright moon. Jagged snow-capped mountains. A small 1980s passenger train, one line of warm lit windows, climbs a winding track along a cliff towards a high notch between two peaks: the Harrow Pass. Old snow glows blue in the moonlight. Calm, beautiful, a little lonely.

The same mountains from closer, minutes later. A wall of heavy cloud pours over the peaks like a wave and swallows the stars one by one. The first big snowflakes catch the beam of the train's headlamp below. The moon is going out. Unease.

Side view of the train in a blizzard, almost lost in driving snow. The carriage windows glow amber; the locomotive's lamp barely cuts through. Snow streaks diagonally across the whole frame. Leave the middle of the sky quiet: the game's title sits there.

Inside an old train carriage, night. James Flint, 26, dark coat, sits alone with a sealed metal evidence box on his knees, looking out of the window. Snow hammers the glass. The carriage lamps flicker. The other seats are empty. Warm interior, cold blue window.
